calculation.description: Fades standardized three-day returns, with greater reversal emphasis for assets in persistent drawdown and exhibiting downside-risk asymmetry. Negative-return volatility is used as the shock scale.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in 2020-2022 (+0.053826), 2023-2024 (+0.025321), and 2025-2027 (+0.035466); weakest regime ICIR remained below the admission threshold in 2023-2024, so uncertainty is material in the 15-asset cross-section.
validation.admission: Passes absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840; high artifact correlation is recorded for deterministic redundancy audit.
